cylinders.description: Cylinders on the rig. Default one single AL80.

cylinder.description: A lookup_cylinders id (al80, steel12-232, hp100) or a plan_dive preset (al80, twin_12l, stage_11l). For twinset and sidemount name ONE cylinder of the pair. Default al80.

cylinder_lead.description: Lead fixed to each cylinder (a tail or V-weight), kg (lb). Default 0.

cylinder_size.description: For a cylinder not in the data: water litres of one cylinder, or ft³ at rated_pressure on imperial. Needs empty_buoyancy.

empty_buoyancy.description: For a cylinder not in the data: buoyancy of one empty cylinder with its valve, kg (lb imperial), negative when it sinks. From the maker's sheet.

helium_pct.description: Helium % of the gas in it. Default 0.

oxygen_pct.description: Oxygen % of the gas in it. Default 21.

rated_pressure.description: Imperial only, with cylinder_size: the psi its ft³ is rated at. Default 3000.

regulator.description: Regulator on each cylinder: travel, standard, cold_water or none. Default by role: standard (single, sidemount), cold_water (twinset), travel (stage).

rigging.description: Count bands, manifold or stage hardware. Default true for twinset, sidemount and stage.

role.description: single, twinset (two on a manifold), sidemount (a pair, one each side) or stage (one slung cylinder; one entry per stage).

start_pressure.description: Fill at the start (bar or psi). Default: the preset fill, else the dataset working pressure.

diver.description: The diver. With no body_offset but height, weight, age and sex, body buoyancy is estimated; with neither it is taken as neutral.

body_fat_pct.description: Body fat %, else estimated from height and weight.

body_offset.description: Personal buoyancy from an in-water weight check, kg (lb), positive floats. Wins over the estimate.

body_offset_water.description: Water type, from its density: en13319 (EN 13319, the dive computer standard) 10.00 m per bar, salt 9.95, fresh 10.20, red_sea 9.92. Default en13319.

height.description: Height, cm (in imperial): 100 to 250 cm (39.4 to 98.4 in).

sex.description: male or female, for the lung and body-fat estimate.

weight.description: Body weight, kg (lb imperial): 20 to 250 kg (44.1 to 551.2 lb).

exposure.description: Exposure suit. Default a 5 mm full wetsuit.

booties_mm.description: Bootie thickness in mm; 0 or omitted for none.

custom_lift.description: Measured suit lift at the surface, kg (lb), instead of the model.

cut.description: Wetsuit cut: full (default), shorty or farmer_john.

gloves_mm.description: Glove thickness in mm; 0 or omitted for none.

hood_mm.description: Hood thickness in mm; 0 or omitted for none.

neoprene.description: Wetsuit foam: soft (new, compresses most), standard (default) or old (about 20% less lift).

thickness_mm.description: Wetsuit neoprene thickness in mm (both unit systems), 0 to 10. Default 5.

undersuit.description: Drysuit undersuit: light, medium (default) or heavy.

vest_mm.description: Vest or hooded vest thickness in mm; 0 or omitted for none.

gear.description: Lead and other gear. Omit to get the lead the rig needs from zero.

ditchable.description: Can be dropped in an emergency. Default false.

label.description: What it is: belt, trim pockets, backplate, torch.

weight.description: In-water weight, kg (lb), positive when it sinks (a 6 kg belt is 6).

target_depth.description: Deepest point of the dive (m or ft), where full cylinders are checked. Default 30 m (98 ft).

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

water.description: Water type, from its density: en13319 (EN 13319, the dive computer standard) 10.00 m per bar, salt 9.95, fresh 10.20, red_sea 9.92. Default en13319.

lift_bag_lift.description: Emergency lift from a lift bag, kg (lb); omit for none.

redundant_bladder_lift.description: Second bladder lift, kg (lb); omit for none.

smb_lift.description: Emergency lift from an SMB, kg (lb); omit for none.

name: buoyancy_check

flooded_suit_ditch.description: Ditchable weight needed to recover from a flooded drysuit.

spoken_summary.description: A few plain sentences for a voice reply, ending with an offer: digits allowed, no symbols or notation.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

water.description: Water type, from its density: en13319 (EN 13319, the dive computer standard) 10.00 m per bar, salt 9.95, fresh 10.20, red_sea 9.92. Default en13319.

weight_adjustment.description: Lead to add or remove to be neutral at the end of the dive, to 0.5 kg.

title: Weighting and buoyancy check
